title: Macrophage-Centered Integration of Single-Cell and Bulk Transcriptomic Data Identifies CCL3, CCL4, and JUNB as Inflammatory Regulatory Signatures in Ulcerative Colitis.
authors: Meng, Haoyang; Chen, Yongliang; Chai, Yongchun; Yu, Sike; Ma, Peiyao; Lei, Ruibin; Zhou, Shuhan; Lv, Wenliang
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合单细胞与批量转录组数据识别溃疡性结肠炎巨噬细胞炎症标志物，虽涉及转录因子活性推断和分子对接，但核心是转录组分析与疾病标志物，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作体系与结合机制建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to identify and characterize macrophage-associated inflammatory regulatory signatures in ulcerative colitis (UC) by integrating bulk and single-cell transcriptomic data, and to explore their potential regulatory and pharmacological relevance. METHODS: Two colonic bulk microarray datasets (GSE179285 and GSE87466) and one single-cell RNA-sequencing dataset (GSE231993) were analyzed. Differential expression analysis, area under the recovery curve-based single-cell gene-set scoring (AUCell) scoring, macrophage high-dimensional Weighted Gene Co-Expression Network Analysis (hdWGCNA), and three machine learning algorithms were combined to prioritize candidate genes. Their expression and diagnostic performance were externally validated. Macrophage trajectory analysis, cell-cell communication analysis, virtual perturbation, transcription factor activity inference, compound prediction, and molecular docking were further performed. RESULTS: Single-cell preprocessing retained 30,737 high-quality cells, and macrophages exhibited relatively high innate immune cell barrier-related gene activity. Integrated screening identified CCL3, CCL4, JUNB, and FOS, whereas machine learning consensus retained CCL3, CCL4, and JUNB as the final signatures. These genes were consistently upregulated in UC, with validation area-under-the-curve values of 0.917, 0.958, and 0.888, respectively. Their expression varied along an inferred macrophage inflammatory state continuum, and UC showed remodeled macrophage-centered communication, including CXCL8-ACKR1 signaling. Virtual perturbation linked CCL3 and CCL4 to chemotaxis and lysosomal programs and JUNB to antigen processing and major histocompatibility complex (MHC) class II pathways; RFX5 was prioritized as a potential upstream regulator. CID11879209 was predicted as a shared candidate compound, with docking energies of -6.55, -6.31, and -4.50 kcal/mol for CCL3, CCL4, and JUNB, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: CCL3, CCL4, and JUNB constitute a macrophage-associated inflammatory signature connecting tissue-level UC dysregulation with macrophage state remodeling. These findings provide testable molecular and pharmacological hypotheses requiring further experimental and clinical validation.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在通过整合批量与单细胞转录组数据，识别并表征溃疡性结肠炎（UC）中巨噬细胞相关的炎症调控特征，并探讨其潜在的调控及药理学意义。方法：分析了两组结肠批量微阵列数据集（GSE179285和GSE87466）及一组单细胞RNA测序数据集（GSE231993）。结合差异表达分析、基于恢复曲线下面积的单细胞基因集评分（AUCell）、巨噬细胞高维加权基因共表达网络分析（hdWGCNA）及三种机器学习算法，以优先筛选候选基因。其表达及诊断性能经外部验证。进一步进行了巨噬细胞轨迹分析、细胞间通讯分析、虚拟扰动、转录因子活性推断、化合物预测及分子对接。结果：单细胞预处理保留了30,737个高质量细胞，巨噬细胞表现出相对较高的先天免疫细胞屏障相关基因活性。整合筛选识别出CCL3、CCL4、JUNB和FOS，而机器学习共识保留CCL3、CCL4和JUNB作为最终特征。这些基因在UC中一致上调，验证曲线下面积值分别为0.917、0.958和0.888。其表达沿推断的巨噬细胞炎症状态连续体变化，且UC显示出重塑的巨噬细胞中心通讯，包括CXCL8-ACKR1信号。虚拟扰动将CCL3和CCL4与趋化及溶酶体程序相关联，JUNB与抗原加工及主要组织相容性复合体（MHC）II类通路相关联；RFX5被优先视为潜在上游调控因子。CID11879209被预测为共享候选化合物，对CCL3、CCL4和JUNB的对接能量分别为-6.55、-6.31和-4.50 kcal/mol。结论：CCL3、CCL4和JUNB构成巨噬细胞相关的炎症特征，连接组织水平UC失调与巨噬细胞状态重塑。这些发现提供了可测试的分子及药理学假设，需进一步的实验和临床验证。
